items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions: 'Tommy's name was already established and he liked Guy Lombardo.'

ctx.x: Yes. But the thing is that Sy, I think -- it's difficult to say, but I think Sy's arrangements gave Tommy a whole new life.
Maybe he kept him going, and it's difficult to say because Tommy's name was already established and he liked Guy Lombardo.
You see, once a thing was established in the dance music field, there was not -- that was it, you were there and you were there to stay.
